# netactuate_storage_block_volume (Resource)

Manages a Storage Block Volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_storage_block_volume" "example" {
  label = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The display label for the block volume

### Optional

- `capacity` (Number) Storage capacity in GB (1-1000)
- `location` (String) Location name where the block volume will be created
- `location_id` (Number) The location ID where the block volume will be created
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `assigned_on` (String) Timestamp when the block volume was assigned
- `block_volume_id` (Number) The ID of the block volume
- `endpoints` (List of String) Block storage endpoint URLs
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image_name` (String) The block storage image name
- `location_name` (String) The name of the location
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the block volume is ready for use
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The Ceph secret key for block storage access
- `storage_cluster_id` (String) The storage cluster ID
- `storage_namespace` (String) The storage namespace
- `storage_pool` (String) The storage pool name
- `total_capacity_gb` (Number) Total provisioned capacity in GB
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) The Ceph user key for block storage access

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

Optional:

- `create` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_storage_block_volume.example 12345
```
